svg.title: StackOne: run actions in a user's linked business apps
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the StackOne capability connects to StackOne's MCP endpoint at api.stackone.com/mcp with your API key and an x-account-id header naming one linked account, and StackOne runs actions against that account's provider, such as BambooHR or Salesforce. In the default search_execute mode the model sees two tools: one ending in _search_actions that returns action ids, and one ending in _execute_action that runs an action by id. Passing actions switches to individual mode, with one tool per matching action, such as bamboohr_list_employees.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
